QuestInfo.name: Secrets of the Wooden Box
QuestInfo.0: #p1002001# asked you to investigate the wooden box that #p20000# always carries around.
QuestInfo.1: You find unidentified medication inside the box.
QuestInfo.2: It turned out that #p20000# had been taking his own special arthritis medicine behind #p1002001#'s back. You made a deal with him, promising not to tell anyone about the contents of his wooden box in exchange for a small reward. You shouldn't tell #p1002001# about the wooden box. Just make something up.

0.0: (Inside the wooden box, there a mysterious form of medication...)

1.0: Hey, that's my arthritis medicine! Well... I recently found a new type of medicine for this, but I didn't get enough, so I kept it a secret and used it all for myself. If Teo finds out about this, things might get a bit awkard between him and me... Please keep this a secret from him, okay? I'll give you a gift.

yes.0: I can trust you on this, right? Please keep it a secret. Oh, and as a token of my appreciation, I'll give you some snail shells used to treat arthritis.
